name: hoarddb
description: The hoardDB driver for Node.js: buckets of six store types over TLS, with key pinning.

scripts.test:server: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=900000 "build/test/server/**/*.test.js"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs dist && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/write-cjs-package.mjs
scripts.pack:check: npm run build && publint && node scripts/pack-smoke.mjs
